run_simple_demo: run a simple offline demo that describes a single image using Mistral-Small-3.1 with vLLM
run_advanced_demo: run an advanced offline demo with multiple images and multi-turn chat using Mistral-Small-3.1
parse_args: parse command line arguments to choose simple or advanced demo mode and model format
main: main entry point that dispatches to simple or advanced demo based on parsed CLI arguments
llm_chat_with_image: use vLLM LLM chat method to send multimodal messages with images and get text responses
